from.name: 1986 Internet congestion-collapse experience and 4.3BSD TCP misbehavior investigation

property: Severe observed Internet congestion and examination of 4.3BSD TCP behavior motivate transport implementation changes organized around packet conservation, improved timers, slow start and congestion avoidance.

sources.locator: Jacobson/Karels paper Introduction and historical motivation
sources.supports: observed severe congestion, implementation diagnosis and algorithmic response

negative_claims: This edge does not imply one single congestion incident was the sole origin of all later TCP congestion control.
It does not make the 1988 paper a new TCP wire-protocol version.
